metaDescription: Order custom cotton badge reels for a soft, comfortable feel. Ideal for daily wear. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Cotton badge reels offer a softer, more comfortable alternative to synthetic materials, making them ideal for employees who wear their ID badges all day. The natural fabric breathes better and reduces skin irritation, especially in warm environments. Available in multiple widths from 3/8" to 1", these reels can be customized with screen-printed logos or text. Many options include retractable reels and breakaway features for safety. Perfect for trade shows, hospitals, or corporate offices seeking a professional yet comfortable look.
heroAltText: Custom cotton badge reels with retractable reel and screen-printed logo on soft fabric lanyard
